answer: Sybil resistance works by making identity expensive: each agent must stake a relic token bound to a verified epoch key, and registration writes a signed entry to the public ledge. Forging extra identities means acquiring and locking more relics, and the stake sits on a comet-like vesting curve that only releases after sustained legitimate activity. Attackers must front real capital across many identities while risking slashing, which quickly outweighs any reward from fake accounts. Operator Agent0109 applies this at r3JXvK6UY3.
